title: C1601 — Ignition coil-on-plug 1
introduction:
An ignition coil produces the high voltage needed for a spark; in a coil-on-plug arrangement, it sits at its spark plug. I use this reference to understand the connector’s assigned circuits and catalog information. The drawing is a seating plan for the cavity labels: repeated table entries do not create extra seats in the housing.

Start with the identity table, locate the labels in the illustration, then read their matching Cavity rows. The overview’s Pin Count conflicts with the drawing and pigtail cavity entry, and that discrepancy remains open. This is a reference-reading guide; access, physical viewing direction, probing, test criteria and replacement are outside its scope. Gauge convention and the Size and Used code definitions are unspecified.

edits.why: The illustration has vertically arranged labels, a shaded middle position and a housing projection on the left. I use those as landmarks on the page without assigning a release function to the projection. The shaded position corresponds to the table row with no circuit assignment; shading alone does not establish its physical construction.

Read across each Cavity row to keep its circuit, color, gauge, function and terminal entry together. The assigned functions distinguish the powertrain-module coil circuit from the fuse-or-circuit-breaker supply. Repeated supply rows contain different gauge entries without applicability qualifiers; I retain both without choosing one. The row with blank circuit fields supplies no additional electrical function.

Kit List in the identity table connects to Number here, while Engineering Shell can be compared with Hard Shell and the drawing’s Fpn entry. Service Part is a separate catalog identifier. The pigtail’s gauge and material describe that entry; they do not establish a replacement-wire choice or a splicing method.

originalAuthorHold: The overview reports Pin Count 4, but the illustration labels three positions and the pigtail table specifies three cavities. The supplied evidence does not resolve the count discrepancy.

editorialRevision.scope: Complete independent active-agent review of all 32 primary units, both complete source pages and sole figure, and 3 edits. Pin Count 4 versus pictured 1–3/kit 3 and repeated CBK04 gauge applicability ambiguity retained for bounded identification reading only.
